name: Alistair McTavish
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport started with a fascination for aircraft as a young boy, building intricate model planes and devouring books on aerodynamics. This passion led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Strathclyde, where he specialized in fluid dynamics and composite materials. His early career saw him working on wind tunnel testing for a Formula Student team, quickly establishing himself as a meticulous and resourceful engineer.

Before joining PEX Motorsport, Alistair honed his skills at several smaller racing outfits, focusing on optimizing aerodynamic packages for various racing series. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing wind tunnel results and on-track performance to identify areas for improvement. Alistair's dedication to precision and his ability to translate complex aerodynamic principles into practical solutions make him a valuable asset to the team. He is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection, often pushing the boundaries of what's possible within the regulations.

At PEX, Alistair has implemented a new simulation process that allows the team to quickly iterate and test new aerodynamic concepts. He fosters a collaborative environment, encouraging his team to share ideas and challenge conventional thinking. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering commitment to excellence.
